title: Just Better Anvil
description: An anvil that can be opend with the comand /anvil
body:
Have u ever wanted to open an anvil without an anvil?

Well NOW you can with the Just Better Anvil plugin by using the /anvil command it will open a virtual functionable anvil!

This plugin was made for SMPs
